column1: # All 185 CRITICAL/HIGH kernel CVEs classed 'present' on the shipped 7.0.0-38 by the exact-byte scan (run 40579 kernel-cves.tsv).

# tracker = ubuntu.com/security/cves/<id>.json linux-hwe-7.0/noble, retrieved 2026-10-29 ~19:0xZ. source: added lines of the upstream fix commit (break-fix, torvalds tree) matched per file against the '+' lines of Ubuntu's linux-hwe-7.0 diff.gz (38: cd0996991ef5…, 42: ab5b2722d3d4…, both verified against the signed Sources index). FIXED-in-42-source = all (>=4 lines: all but one) fix lines in 42 and not in 38. PARTIAL / ABSENT-42 / no-comparable-lines under a 'pending' tracker status = NOT verified by this method (likely context-adapted backports, but not claimed).
